name: mandamistan
description: How Mamdani fixes the New York housing crisis, with receipts. The crisis in sourced numbers (1.41% vacancy, 51.6% rent-burdened, 100k in shelters), the Block by Block plan pillar by pillar (freeze + 200k built + 200k preserved + NYCHA + rezoning + tenant power), a promised-to-delivered timeline (the Oct 1 2026 rent freeze is live), the strongest critiques with their counters, and a transparent what-if simulator. Visual console + JSON API, static data, stdlib only, every figure cited.

endpoints.GET /info: Null call — what this module is
endpoints.GET /crisis: The NYC housing crisis in numbers, every figure sourced
endpoints.GET /plan: Block by Block: the whole plan, pillar by pillar
endpoints.GET /critiques: The strongest objections, and the counters
endpoints.GET /simulate: Project affordable stock + tenant savings (new_per_year, preserved_per_year, freeze_years, rgb_hike, attrition_per_year, median_stabilized_rent, years)
